about: Every file of chronos's runtime/, forge/, scripts/, ui/, desktop/ and docs/, sorted. keep: copied as it is (scripts/sync-check.mjs says when it drifts). reuse: copied, then trimmed here. rewrite: written fresh in Lite. never: a cut part or personal data; it does not ship. own: a file of Lite's with no Chronos file behind it (listed from stage 4).
